verdict.rationale: Billing proration is a fair question for a subscription billing platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents prorated credits, partial-period charges, or reconciling invoice line items for mid-cycle plan changes. The nearby items cover other things: multi-frequency billing, quote estimates, and RevRec handling of contract modifications for revenue recognition. None of them is the proration capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, mid-cycle upgrades and downgrades are prorated with documented, auditable math — credits, partial periods, and invoice line items that reconcile to the penny
